cookies.intro: This page explains which cookies and personal data AURORA Restaurant uses. It is written to align with GDPR and Uzbek law.
cookies.s1Body: Essential: language choice and cookie consent. Optional: third-party cookies from the Google Maps embed — only after you allow them or load the map.
cookies.s2Body: The reservation form, language and anti-spam protections are necessary processing. Google Analytics loads only after “Accept all”. Vercel Analytics is cookieless first-party measurement.
cookies.s3Body: Supabase (menu and bookings), Telegram (admin alerts, via our server), Vercel Analytics, optional Google Analytics (after consent) and Google Maps (after consent). Each has its own privacy terms.
cookies.s4Body: You can update consent at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer. Without essential cookies, language will not be remembered.
cookies.s5Body: You may request access, correction or deletion. Under GDPR you may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Contact: info@aurora.uz.

privacy.intro: This policy explains how AURORA Restaurant (Tashkent) collects, stores and uses personal data of website visitors and guests.
privacy.s1Body: When you reserve: name, phone, date, time, party size and table. Optional notes. IP address may be stored briefly for anti-spam.
privacy.s2Body: To book a table, confirm the evening, contact you and meet legal duties. We do not send marketing without consent.
privacy.s3Body: Data is stored in our booking system (Supabase) and, for confirmation, sent to the restaurant’s Telegram admin channel. We do not sell it.
privacy.s4Body: Reservation records are kept for service and accounting, then deleted or anonymised. Cookie consent is stored on your device.
privacy.s5Body: To see, correct or delete your data, write to info@aurora.uz or call +998 71 200 00 00. We aim to reply within 14 days.
